house_style: Muted, realistic digital painting for the background of a high school math tool with a dark interface. Low contrast, deep blues, calm and quiet. No text, no letters, no watermark, no border, no frame.
style: None needed: the machines, conveyors, tokens, gate, chute and graph are all drawn in code (SVG). The spec's optional brushed-steel texture was not used; the floor plate is a code gradient with rivets.
